title: Pro-etale common-left-adjunction decomposition
statement: For the small etale data of [lem-weil-closed-costalk-duality], the two displayed derived internal-Hom functors admit a common left adjoint.

proof.text: Use evaluation-normalized closedAdjunction at T and Z; substitute its equality with the native monoidal structure. Native symmetry on T supplies the ambient symmetry. Apply the site-specific closed-support tensor projection. The fully proved generic common-left theorem constructs both adjunctions, with F = closed direct image followed by fixed-target dual.rightOp.

proof_origin.place: The displayed natural Hom chain, using the native tensor-Hom adjunction and the separately stated middle projection formula.
